fieldValues.title: Keep the flow joined
fieldValues.description: Sweep the governed repositories with clerk flow --open: join every dot clerk flow marks auto, citing its rule (lane or group label, the sub-issue link a Part of names, the blocked-by link a Blocked by names); never guess a choice. Report, per repository, the issues that flow and the choices left for a person (two holding groups, an existing parent, a parked epic, a missing problem or plan).
fieldValues.done_when: Every open issue under a ranked epic has its mechanical dots joined, and the report lists each choice left with the issue it belongs to.
fieldValues.trigger: daily, before the board sync that fills Ready (proposed)
fieldValues.size: The governed repositories, open issues only
